dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL for Windows/Linux with screen handling (CRT STATUS, EVENT STATUS), COMP-X usage, and extensive COPY-based modular structure. Italian-language ERP/accounting system (PRAGMA software house). Uses Micro Focus-style GUI/screen controls with control IDs.
evidence: extensive COPY .sel and .lib files typical of Micro Focus ISAM-based apps

purpose.domain_detail: Italian financial/accounting ERP system (PRAGMA) - anagrafica (master data) management for clients/suppliers/chart of accounts with links to balance sheet (CEE/IAS), cost centers, ABI/CAB bank codes, payment codes, contacts, notes, etc.
purpose.summary: This is a large interactive program for maintaining master data (anagrafica) records in an Italian accounting/ERP system. It supports insert, update, query, delete, and search operations on financial master records including clients, suppliers, chart of accounts entries, balance sheet codes (CEE and IAS), cost centers, bank codes (ABI/CAB), and related entities. The program uses a GUI-style screen interface with control IDs and multiple tabs/pages.

notable_features: CRT STATUS / EVENT STATUS screen handling (Micro Focus GUI)
100 COPY statements for modular file/data definitions
191 CALL statements indicating heavy subprogram use
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric fields
Inline comments with change history tags (SET09, MAR10, Tan-i, Tan-f)
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars of a 347KB, 8045-line file. The program is clearly a large production system from an Italian software house (PRAGMA), written for a financial/accounting application. The 'online-cics' program_type is used loosely here - it is actually a Micro Focus interactive screen program, not CICS. Date written June 1997 with modifications through April 2010. Decoded as latin-1 due to Italian characters (e.g. accented letters in comments).
